Minimal preset preserves nav, footer, aside

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"preprocessing\":{\"preset\":\"Minimal\"}}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<nav>Navigation</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer>", options_handle);
    htm_conversion_options_free(options_handle);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
